name: Grapple
additional_info: Requires Familiar Prosthetic Arm to use. Upon using the provided tool, grapple to your cursor location and pull yourself towards it at high speeds. If your cursor is hovering over a player or NPC on use, pull them towards you as well, similarly to the Lord's Slice Mantra.
desc: Aim your mouse and shoot a grapple from your metal arm to your target and pull yourself towards it.
